name: astra
description: ASTRA methodology plugin. Sprint 0 project initialization, automatic coding convention enforcement (Java/TypeScript/React Native/Python/CSS/SCSS), Korean public data standard, international code standards (ISO 3166-1/2, ITU-T E.164), naming validation, quality gates, Slack integration, service manual auto-generation, UX/UI/Dev/QA Screen-ID based Handoff package auto-generation (HANDOFF_PROCESS_GUIDE v1.1), role-based persona agents (planner / designer / developer / tester validation and delegation), and the /autorun self-improving pipeline (planning → test auto-execution + up to N iteration self-improvement loop, with early termination on test pass). v5.7.0: /tool-author skill added for runtime LLM tool surface authoring + validation (Anthropic Tool Use, MCP, LangChain @tool, Pydantic, Zod). Enforces 6 required attributes and blocks 7 failure modes (wrong-tool selection, skipped tool, malformed args, retry loops, intent bypass, wrong side-effect, un-auditable traces). Auto-trigger via paths (tools/**, mcp/**, **/tools.py, src/**/*.tool.ts). Distinct from /skill-author (which targets ASTRA SKILL.md files). v5.6.0: /pr-merge cascade merge restricted to `staging → dev` only — `main → staging` is no longer auto-cascaded; `main` is touched only via the explicit `--main` promotion. Promotion modes (`--staging`, `--main`) skip the cascade entirely. Training docs (branch-strategy 1pager / ko / vi) and CLAUDE.md updated to reflect the new single-hop cascade flow. v5.5.0: Full English localization of plugin internals (skills, commands, agents, hooks, scripts, docs, CLAUDE.md). Skill description language policy now mandates English for all skills (auto-trigger accuracy + consistency). Runtime end-user output language remains controlled by /select-language (Korean / Vietnamese / English). Korean public-data dictionary terms, prefixes/suffixes (TB_, _YMD, etc.), and dictionary field names (공통표준용어명, etc.) are preserved as data definitions. v5.4.0: DESIGN.md design system SSoT introduced (Google Stitch + ASTRA 3-tier hybrid). Four new skills/commands — /design-init (generates DESIGN.md + auto-regenerates design-tokens.css), /design-extract (extracts OKLCH tokens from image/PDF/URL references), /design-redesign (audits UI against DESIGN.md + applies P0 fixes automatically), /design-audit (lightweight token-violation report). design-token-validator now recognizes DESIGN.md as SSoT and treats design-tokens.css as a generated artifact. /service-planner Step E loads DESIGN.md first; /handoff-publish 6-component-specs.md references DESIGN.md §4. PostToolUse hook (notify-design-md.sh) added to advise DESIGN.md consultation on UI code edits — throttled, non-blocking. v5.3.0: Plugin-required MCPs reorganized — `fect-slack` removed from plugin-required MCPs (still usable via user-scope MCP registration by /slack-import, /extract-backlog, /sprint-progress); `fect-image` (Gemini, requires GOOGLE_API_KEY) and `fect-gpt-image` (OpenAI gpt-image-2, requires OPENAI_API_KEY) added for AI image generation; `chrome-devtools` (chrome-devtools-mcp@latest) MCP added as a first-class required MCP for /manual-generator screenshots, /catalog-generator visual capture, and /test-run browser-based integration testing. SessionStart hook updated to report GOOGLE_API_KEY/OPENAI_API_KEY activation status. v5.2.0: /sprint-init --auto stage-to-stage flow replaced from 'exit + user --resume' pattern with 'Silent Save Protocol (save auto-state.yaml + commit, then continue automatically to next stage)'. The LLM avoids re-referencing large prior artifacts (reference-avoidance) so Claude Code's built-in auto-compression works effectively. --resume is now reserved strictly for true recovery (context loss, crash, forced interrupt). v5.1.0: /blueprint dedicated skill added — 10 standard-section blueprint focused on data flow, schema, API contract, sequence diagrams, and pseudocode logic (no executable code). Section 10 'HITL Triggers' gates HITL invocation during /feature-dev's implementation phase. /sprint-init prompt-map Step 1.1 and /autorun Stage 3 delegate to the new skill. v4.0.0: /ux-publish removed; HTML mockup generation integrated into /service-planner Step 6.

plugins.description: ASTRA methodology plugin with coding convention enforcement, data standard, international code standards, naming validation, quality gates, Slack integration, service manual auto-generator, UX/UI/Dev/QA Screen-ID based handoff package generator, role-based persona agents, and /autorun self-improving full pipeline. v5.7.0 NEW: /tool-author skill — authors and validates runtime LLM tool descriptions and input schemas (Anthropic Tool Use, MCP server.tool(), LangChain @tool, Pydantic, Zod). Enforces six required attributes and blocks seven failure modes (wrong-tool selection, skipped tool, malformed arguments, retry loops, user-intent bypass, wrong side-effect, un-auditable traces). Auto-trigger via tools/mcp path conventions. Scoped distinctly from /skill-author (which targets ASTRA SKILL.md files). v5.5.0 NEW: Full English localization of plugin internals (skills, commands, agents, hooks, scripts, docs, CLAUDE.md). Skill description language policy now mandates English for all skills (auto-trigger accuracy + consistency). Runtime end-user output language remains controlled by /select-language (Korean / Vietnamese / English). Korean public-data dictionary terms, prefixes/suffixes (TB_, _YMD, etc.), and dictionary field names (공통표준용어명, etc.) are preserved as data definitions. v5.4.0 NEW: DESIGN.md as design system SSoT — four new skills/commands (/design-init, /design-extract, /design-redesign, /design-audit). design-token-validator treats DESIGN.md as SSoT and src/styles/design-tokens.css as a generated artifact regenerable via `/design-init --regenerate-css`. /service-planner Step E loads DESIGN.md as primary token + persona source; /handoff-publish 6-component-specs.md references DESIGN.md §4. New PostToolUse hook notify-design-md.sh advises DESIGN.md consultation on UI source edits (throttled, non-blocking). /project-init bootstraps DESIGN.md during Sprint 0. v5.3.0 NEW: Required MCP servers reorganized — `fect-slack` removed from plugin-required MCPs (still consumed by /slack-import, /extract-backlog, /sprint-progress via user-scope MCP registration), `fect-image` (Gemini 2.5 Flash Image, requires GOOGLE_API_KEY) and `fect-gpt-image` (OpenAI gpt-image-2, requires OPENAI_API_KEY) added for /catalog-generator image generation, and `chrome-devtools` (chrome-devtools-mcp@latest) added as a first-class required MCP for /manual-generator screenshots, /catalog-generator visual capture, and /test-run browser-based integration testing. v5.2.0 NEW: /sprint-init --auto now uses a Silent Save Protocol — between stages it writes auto-state.yaml + commits and continues directly to the next stage (no exit, no user --resume). A 'reference-avoidance' rule keeps the LLM from re-reading large prior artifacts so Claude Code's built-in auto-compression handles context. --resume is reserved for true crash/interrupt recovery. v5.1.0 NEW: /blueprint dedicated skill — 10 standard sections focused on data flow, schema DDL, API contract, sequence diagrams, pseudocode logic (no implementation code), plus a Section 10 'HITL Triggers' that /feature-dev consults during implementation to ask the user only on critical decisions (business decisions without a clear blueprint answer, security/permission choices, external dependency introduction, destructive changes). /sprint-init prompt-map Step 1.1 and /autorun Stage 3 now delegate to this skill. Single source of truth: the blueprint itself gates HITL — no external hook needed. v5.0.0 BREAKING: Sprint-level worktree model. /sprint-init creates `.astra-worktrees/sprint-<N>-<name>/` with sprint branch and port-isolated `.astra-worktree.env`; all dev + test happen inside the worktree. /test-run no longer touches dev — it sources the env, launches on the sprint port, and guarantees port release via 4-step cleanup. /pr-merge runs from the worktree, merges to dev, then auto-removes the worktree. REMOVED: /pr-merge --start mode; main-worktree guards on /test-run and /test-scenario; /test-run dev-commit + dev→staging promotion (moved to /pr-merge). v4.0.0 BREAKING: /ux-publish removed; HTML mockup generation integrated into /service-planner Step 6.
